name: bare-mobile-doctor
description: Doctor application for Bare on mobile

scripts.link: npm run link:ios && npm run link:android
scripts.build:android: bare-build --host android-arm64 --runtime bare-native/runtime --name "Doctor Native" --identifier to.holepunch.bare.doctor.native --out build/android native/index.js
scripts.build:ios: bare-build --host ios-arm64 --runtime bare-native/runtime --name "Doctor Native" --config native/build.js --out build/ios native/index.js
scripts.native:android: npm run build:android && bare scripts/run.mjs android "build/android/Doctor Native.apk"
scripts.native:ios: npm run build:ios && bare scripts/run.mjs ios "build/ios/Doctor Native.app"
scripts.gen:udx: npx bare-pack --out app/views/udx/udx.bundle.js bare/udx.js --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked
scripts.gen:hyperdb: npx bare-pack --out app/views/hyperdb/hyperdb.bundle.js bare/hyperdb/hyperdb.mjs --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked
scripts.gen:ipc: npx bare-pack --out app/views/ipc/ipc.bundle.js bare/ipc.js --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked
scripts.gen:hypercore: npx bare-pack --out app/views/hypercore/hypercore.bundle.js bare/hypercore/hypercore.mjs --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked
scripts.gen:os: npx bare-pack --out app/views/os/os.bundle.js bare/os.js --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked
scripts.gen:checksum: npx bare-pack --out app/views/checksum/checksum.bundle.js bare/checksum.js --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked
scripts.gen:videocapture: npx bare-pack --out app/views/videocapture/videocapture.bundle.js bare/videocapture.js --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked

scripts.gen:bluetooth: npx bare-pack --out app/views/bluetooth/bluetooth.bundle.js bare/bluetooth.js --host ios-arm64 --host ios-arm64-simulator --host ios-x64-simulator --host android-arm --host android-arm64 --host android-ia32 --host android-x64 --linked
